'''Ossluk's gloves''' were believed to have belonged to the [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] [[Soldier/Legends|warrior]] [[Ossluk Noslee]]. In their cultural tradition, the Gand [[Species/Legends|species]] typically did not identify individuals by name, so the fact that Ossluk earned two names was a testament to his achievements and prowess as a warrior. These [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Glove/Legends|gloves]] helped the wearer by giving a small improvement in capabilities necessary in combat. Near the end of the [[Dark Wars]]<ref name="kotor2" /> in [[3951 BBY]],<ref name="kotorcg">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> these gloves were no longer in possession of this Gand.<ref name="kotor2" /> Around that [[Time/Legends|time]], Ossluk's gloves were valued at around 25,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="kotor2" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I heard that a mighty Gand warrior is on Nar Shaddaa. I think he is even in this very room! I was wondering if you might find out his name for me.|translated=1|A Sullustan giving a task to the Jedi Exile|<ref name="k2dlg1">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'' dialogue file, StrRef 115606</ref>}}
In the cut content of the [[2004]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', the [[Meetra Surik|Jedi Exile]]&mdash;the player character in the game&mdash;is tasked with a side quest called "Naming of the Gand," in which the Exile must find a name of a certain Gand.<ref name="k2dlg1" /> Upon finding the Gand, he reveals the name.<ref name="k2dlg2">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'' dialogue file, StrRef 115572</ref> Although the quest was cut from the game, the item called "Ossluk's gloves" is still obtainable in the released version by either purchasing them from a merchant or collecting them from defeated enemies, who may randomly drop the gloves. In the game, the wearer of these gloves are given a small boost in strength, constitution and dexterity.<ref name="kotor2" />
